module_summary: Shared-bus AXI crossbar: a round-robin arbiter grants one slave-port AW/AR request, an FSM latches the address, decodes the target master by address map, then forwards W/R bursts through skid buffers and returns B responses.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Transaction FSM: idle, decode, write, write-resp, drop, read, wait-idle; sequences all channel handshakes.

anchors.name: s_select
anchors.why: Granted slave index from arbiter; selects which slave port's channels are muxed in.

anchors.name: m_select_reg
anchors.why: Decoded target master index; selects master-side channel mux and per-master valid/ready bits.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded arbiter grant; upper bits give slave select, LSB gives read/write.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid; starts a transaction from IDLE and ends WAIT_IDLE.

anchors.name: read
anchors.why: Read/write type of granted request; steers address capture and FSM branch.

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Address decode hit; chooses forwarding states versus decode-error drop states.

anchors.name: axi_addr_reg
anchors.why: Latched transaction address; drives master AW/AR address and address-map decode.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-address valid; forms the write requests to the arbiter.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave read-address valid; forms the read requests to the arbiter.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Slave write data, muxed by s_select into the W skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data broadcast to masters from the W output register.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Master read data, muxed by m_select_reg into the R skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to slave ports from the R output register.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave write address muxed and latched into axi_addr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Master write address driven from latched axi_addr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Write-address valid to selected master, raised in WRITE state.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Read-address valid to selected master, raised in READ state.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid to slave; also used in arbiter acknowledge.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid to slave from R skid buffer; part of acknowledge.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Accepts the granted slave's write address in IDLE.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector built from per-slave awvalid/arvalid.

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Releases arbiter grant on final B or last R handshake.

anchors.name: axi_addr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pending-address flag; issues master awvalid/arvalid once per transaction.

anchors.name: axi_len_reg
anchors.why: Latched burst length; decremented to count beats in READ_DROP.

anchors.name: axi_id_reg
anchors.why: Latched transaction ID returned on bid and rid.

anchors.name: axi_prot_reg
anchors.why: Latched protection bits; gates secure-master decode match.

anchors.name: axi_bresp_reg
anchors.why: Holds write response or decode error for slave bresp.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: R channel output register of skid buffer feeding s_axi_rdata.

anchors.name: temp_s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: R skid buffer temp register holding data when output stalls.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready_int_reg
anchors.why: R skid buffer input-ready; gates transfers and READ_DROP progress.

anchors.name: store_axi_r_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable moving R data into output register.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata_reg
anchors.why: W channel output register of skid buffer feeding m_axi_wdata.

anchors.name: temp_m_axi_wdata_reg
anchors.why: W skid buffer temp register holding data when master stalls.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready_int_reg
anchors.why: W skid buffer input-ready; gates W data transfers.

anchors.name: store_axi_w_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable moving W data into output register.

groups.name: transaction_fsm
groups.description: FSM sequencing address capture, decode, data forwarding, responses and drop handling.

groups.name: request_arbiter
groups.description: Round-robin arbiter over per-slave AW/AR requests, released by acknowledge.

groups.name: slave_side_mux
groups.description: Selects the granted slave port's channel signals using s_select.

groups.name: address_decode_master_mux
groups.description: Address map decode picks target master; m_select_reg muxes master channels.

groups.name: address_holding_regs
groups.description: Latched AW/AR attributes broadcast to masters and response fields to slaves.

groups.name: r_skid_buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer returning read data and valid to slave ports.

groups.name: w_skid_buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer forwarding write data and valid to masters.

groups.name: external_axi_ports
groups.description: Slave-side and master-side AXI channel payloads and handshakes.
